sections.behaviour_description: Which links in a post are recorded as references.
sections.display_description: Where references appear, and how many are shown before the list is cut.
sections.discovery_description: The widgets built from the reference graph.
sections.maintenance_description: How long a reference to something deleted is kept.
sections.extensions_description: Settings other extensions add to this page.

settings.enabled_help: Off means nothing new is recorded. Existing references stay.
settings.extract_url_references_help: A link to a discussion or a post in this forum becomes a reference.
settings.extract_short_references_help: The @"Discussion title"#d123 form, inserted by typing # in the composer.
settings.extract_mention_references_help: Needs Mentions. Without it a reply shows in two lists that do not agree.
settings.event_post_enabled_help: Adds a line to the referenced discussion saying where it was linked from. Consecutive lines are merged into one.
settings.max_preview_help: The rest are behind a button.
settings.related_discussions_enabled_help: Worked out from which discussions get cited together, not from tags or titles.
settings.related_discussions_limit_help: In the sidebar of a discussion.
settings.related_max_candidates_help: A ceiling, so a heavily cited discussion cannot make this expensive.
settings.cache_ttl_help: How long the list and the graph are kept before being worked out again. 0 turns caching off.
settings.graph_max_depth_help: How many steps out from a discussion the graph reaches.
settings.graph_max_per_hop_help: Beyond this the graph shows the most recent and says so.
settings.notify_followers_help: Needs Subscriptions. Off means only the author of what was referenced hears about it.
settings.broken_retention_days_help: A reference to something deleted stays in the report this long. 0 keeps them forever.
